profile.summary: Ethan-Arrowood is a senior-level backend JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Fastify, TypeScript, and Node.js asynchronous patterns. Their contributions focus on improving Fastify's core functionality through API refactoring, type safety enhancements, and comprehensive testing. They demonstrate strong skills in plugin development (e.g., fastify-jwt-authz) and maintain high standards for documentation and community contributions. Their work shows a testing-first approach and a keen understanding of Node.js runtime compatibility.
skill_evidence: Promisified Fastify's ContentParser API with proper error typing (PR #2)
Improved Fastify logger type declarations for better TypeScript compatibility (PR #13)
Added async test cases to improve code coverage (PR #2, PR #6)
Refactored validation logic for cleaner schema validation (PR #8)
Added HTTP/2 Node.js version compatibility checks (PR #7)
Documented fastify-jwt-authz plugin in ecosystem documentation (PR #3)
Updated TypeScript ESLint dependencies for better tooling support (PR #12)
Added Node.js 12 to CI pipeline for broader version testing (PR #11)
